citation: Government Notice No. 1132 of 2011 — The Forest (Amendment) Regulations, 2011 (made under s. 106(1) of the Forest Act, Cap. 323)
renumberingNote: Cites s. 106(1) as printed at publication (Act No. 14 of 2002 numbering). In Cap. 323 R.E. 2023 the regulation-making power appears at s. 107 (see card a107). The as-printed citation is kept; it is not modernised.
commencementNote: No express commencement provision; date of publication recorded, commencement not asserted.
signature: Ezekiel M. Maige, Minister for Natural Resources and Tourism, Dar es Salaam, 11th November 2011

events.note: Substitutes the title of PART VII with 'CLASSIFICATION, FEE RATES FOR PERMITS, LICENCES FOR FELLING TREES, COLLECTING FOREST PRODUCE AND OTHER SERVICES'.
Inserts new regulation 29A (classification of tree species from non-plantation forests per Part I of the Fourteenth Schedule).

verification.note: Retrieved from a low-quality OCR of a poor scan (TanzLII). The notice header prints GN No. 1132 but the page running heads print 'GN. No. 432' — a discrepancy in the source copy itself. This instrument was MISSING from the PWA v0.6 amendment chain and has been added to the repo.
